scenarios.description: On the Rebalance Day, Index Component A is included in TheIndex. On that day, its relevant Exchange is open for trading, and the day is not a scheduled shortened period and trading does not cease before the scheduled closing time.
On the Rebalance Day, Index Component B is included in TheIndex. Its relevant Exchange is closed for the entire day, there is no market disruption counterfactual, and none of the exclusions apply.
A day is the Calculation Day immediately following the Rebalance Day, and Index Component C is included in TheIndex on that Calculation Day, but C was not included in TheIndex at the Rebalance Day.

For a valid Trading Day context, the Index Administrator is said to be responsible for deciding whether the day is a Trading Day, but the scenario does not specify any actual decision outcome or whether the day is ultimately treated as a Trading Day.
